title: Building a brand: CIEE Capsule presentation

pages.text:
Zoe, Carson, Sofia, Lauren, Sebastian
apsule

“74% of people want to be more sustainable about the 
clothes they wear, but 27% struggled with identifying 
more sustainable fashion items – suggesting that there 
is a big gap between consumers’ intentions and the 
information that they are able to access.”
- Vogue Business

Introduction 
-
Brand that makes rentable clothes for CIEE locations
-
Styled according to location of study
-
Students pay rental fee at the beginning of the block
-
Followed by unlimited use during their stay
-
Items will be high quality
-
Can be found in each CIEE program’s building
-
Boutique-inspired experience
-
Almost like an airport boutique

Business Model 
Business Model
 • B2C rental-based fashion service
 • Revenue from upfront rental fee
 • Circular usage model (rent → use → return)
 • Mixed strategy (offer + demand driven)
Sourcing & Production
 • Focus on high-quality, durable garments
 • Full package / selective manufacturing partnerships
 • Strategy-based sourcing (near & outsourced)
Retail Offer
 • Boutique-style experience inside CIEE buildings
 • Location-curated clothing selections
 • Convenient & experience-driven service

Sustainability 
Sustainability Approach
• Promotes reuse instead of fast consumption
• Reduces overbuying & textile waste
• High-quality garments with longer lifespan
• Lower environmental impact per wear
Circular System
• Rent → Use → Return → Re-rental
• Minimizes unnecessary production
• Encourages responsible consumption habits

Perspective
●
Solves a real behavioral problem: emotional overpacking & 
impulse buying abroad
●
Reframes ownership → access (experience over 
accumulation)
●
Aligns with Gen Z values: sustainability, mobility, identity
●
Strengthens CIEE’s positioning as innovative & 
future-oriented
●
Scalable circular model within an existing global 
infrastructure
●
Encourages mindful consumption without sacrificing style
Future Outlook: positioned for long-term growth as rental 
culture and circular fashion continue expanding globally
